source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: While Counterstrategist is active through [Hero of Hades Hive](vsdata:ability/astra-militarum.commissar-yarrick.hero-of-hades-hive), use it as the opponent’s [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) ends. Pick an enemy that finished a move or was set up within 8″ of Yarrick. Within 6″ of Yarrick, choose a friendly REGIMENT unit he can see. That unit is ineligible if it took a [Normal Move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move) or was targeted by [Fire Overwatch](vsdata:core-rule/fire-overwatch) during this phase. Choose one response. Move up to D6″ using a Normal Move, shoot solely at the chosen enemy subject to normal target eligibility, or declare a charge. For the rest of the phase, its ranged attacks hit on unmodified 6s regardless of Ballistic Skill or modifiers. The [Charge Move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move) must engage the chosen enemy. A successful charge grants the REGIMENT unit no Charge Bonus this turn.
